title: Calibrated inference for targeted tissue sampling
validation: All remaining 14 CRC and 6 STARmap samples; no outcome-based exclusions
primary_outcomes: Three neighborhood prevalence endpoints per specimen; cell abundance is a negative control for truncation
statistics: equal specimen weighting; no treatment-effect inference or independent-cell pseudoreplication
finite_sample_bound: Bernstein variance upper bound plus Bernstein total bound; separate from approximate t intervals
novelty: Integrated acquisition and inference workflow; HT weighting, guard regions and model assistance are established components and will be credited

implementation_correction.reason: Exclude anchor self-matches when marker-high labels overlap; same rule for all cohorts and simulations. All primary and sensitivity runs repeated. No change to design, estimator or evaluation criteria.

mechanistic_baseline: Complete-support inclusion estimator with exact Bernoulli product variance, added before interpreting aggregate validation results.
